examples.text_en: The sudden change remains an enigma to us.
examples.text_zh: 这个突然的变化对我们来说仍是个谜。

examples.text_en: His quiet smile was a complete enigma.
examples.text_zh: 他沉默的微笑完全是个谜。

examples.text_en: The doctor enjoined him to rest for a week.
examples.text_zh: 医生嘱咐他休息一周。

examples.text_en: She enjoined her students to read the book.
examples.text_zh: 她吩咐学生们读这本书。

examples.text_en: Could you enlighten us on this matter?
examples.text_zh: 你能就这件事给我们一些启发吗？

examples.text_en: Her words enlightened the young readers.
examples.text_zh: 她的话启发了年轻的读者。

examples.text_en: The talk was deeply enlightening for us.
examples.text_zh: 这次讲话对我们深有启发。

examples.text_en: He found the lesson truly enlightening.
examples.text_zh: 他觉得这堂课真的很有启发性。

examples.text_en: The book brought him a sense of enlightenment.
examples.text_zh: 这本书给他带来一种启迪。

examples.text_en: True enlightenment comes from within, not books.
examples.text_zh: 真正的启迪来自内心，而非书本。

examples.text_en: They will enlist young men for the long work.
examples.text_zh: 他们将为这项长期工作招募年轻人。

examples.text_en: He tried to enlist our help for the new plan.
examples.text_zh: 他设法为这个新计划争取我们的帮助。

examples.text_en: A little music can enliven the party.
examples.text_zh: 一点音乐能让聚会活跃起来。

examples.text_en: Her jokes enlivened the long meeting.
examples.text_zh: 她的笑话让漫长的会议活跃起来。

examples.text_en: The fine net would enmesh the small fish.
examples.text_zh: 细密的网会缠住那些小鱼。

examples.text_en: He did not want to enmesh us in his fight.
examples.text_zh: 他不想让我们卷入他的争斗。

examples.text_en: Years of enmity divided the two families.
examples.text_zh: 多年的敌意使两家人彼此疏远。

examples.text_en: They buried their enmity and became friends.
examples.text_zh: 他们抛开了敌意，成了朋友。

examples.text_en: The king will ennoble him for his great work.
examples.text_zh: 国王将因他的功绩授予他爵位。

examples.text_en: Hard work can ennoble a man in the eyes of all.
examples.text_zh: 辛勤的劳动能让一个人在众人眼中变得高贵。

examples.text_en: A long quiet day can bring a deep ennui.
examples.text_zh: 漫长安静的一天会带来深深的倦怠。

examples.text_en: He felt a strange ennui in the new city.
examples.text_zh: 他在新城感到一种莫名的厌倦。

examples.text_en: The enormity of the crime shocked everyone.
examples.text_zh: 这桩罪行的极恶震惊了所有人。

examples.text_en: Nobody understood the enormity of the loss.
examples.text_zh: 没有人明白这损失之大。

examples.text_en: She came to enquire about the new school.
examples.text_zh: 她来打听这所新学校的情况。

examples.text_en: We must enquire at the office for the facts.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须到办公室去问明情况。

examples.text_en: He made an enquiry about the lost book.
examples.text_zh: 他询问了那本丢失的书。

examples.text_en: Her enquiry brought a quick and kind answer.
examples.text_zh: 她的询问很快得到了友善的回答。

examples.text_en: His rude reply enraged the teacher.
examples.text_zh: 他无礼的回答激怒了老师。

examples.text_en: Such careless waste enrages many people.
examples.text_zh: 如此随意的浪费激怒了许多人。

examples.text_en: The music enraptured the entire audience.
examples.text_zh: 音乐使全场观众欣喜若狂。

examples.text_en: Her voice enraptures everyone who listens.
examples.text_zh: 她的歌声使每个倾听的人都欣喜万分。

examples.text_en: The enrolment of new students starts next week.
examples.text_zh: 新生的注册下周开始。

examples.text_en: Their school saw a large enrolment this year.
examples.text_zh: 他们学校今年招生人数很多。

examples.text_en: She ensconced herself in a quiet corner.
examples.text_zh: 她把自己安顿在一个安静的角落。

examples.text_en: He ensconced the child near the warm fire.
examples.text_zh: 他把孩子安置在暖和的火边。

examples.text_en: The jazz ensemble played with great spirit.
examples.text_zh: 这支爵士乐团演奏得充满活力。

examples.text_en: She wore a lovely ensemble to the party.
examples.text_zh: 她穿了一套漂亮的全套服装去参加聚会。

examples.text_en: The law enshrines the right to free speech.
examples.text_zh: 这项法律铭记并保障言论自由的权利。

examples.text_en: We enshrine his memory in our hearts.
examples.text_zh: 我们把他铭记在心中。

examples.text_en: The ensign flew above the small ship.
examples.text_zh: 旗帜在小船上方飘扬。

examples.text_en: A young ensign took charge of the boat.
examples.text_zh: 一位年轻的海军少尉接管了这条船。

examples.text_en: They tried to enslave the people of the town.
examples.text_zh: 他们想奴役镇上的百姓。

examples.text_en: Fear can enslave a man and take his hope.
examples.text_zh: 恐惧能奴役一个人，夺走他的希望。

examples.text_en: The hunter tried to ensnare a wild bird.
examples.text_zh: 猎人想诱捕一只野鸟。

examples.text_en: They were ensnared by a clever trick.
examples.text_zh: 他们被一个巧妙的圈套骗住了。

examples.text_en: A long talk would ensue after the great news.
examples.text_zh: 这个重大消息之后会有一场长谈。

examples.text_en: Hard times may ensue if we do nothing now.
examples.text_zh: 如果我们现在什么都不做，艰难的日子可能接踵而至。

examples.text_en: This work will entail many long and hard days.
examples.text_zh: 这项工作需要付出许多漫长而辛苦的日子。

examples.text_en: The new plan may entail a change of place.
examples.text_zh: 新计划可能需要换个地方。

examples.text_en: The long line would entangle the two boats.
examples.text_zh: 长绳子会把两条船缠在一起。

examples.text_en: He did not want to entangle her in this.
examples.text_zh: 他不想把她卷进这件事。

examples.text_en: The entanglement of the lines took some time.
examples.text_zh: 解开这些缠绕的绳子花了一些时间。

examples.text_en: He kept out of the entanglement of the group.
examples.text_zh: 他没有卷入这个团体的纷争。

examples.text_en: She is an enterprising young woman with big plans.
examples.text_zh: 她是个有魄力的年轻女子，胸怀大计。

examples.text_en: The enterprising man started a new business.
examples.text_zh: 这个有进取心的男人开创了一番新事业。

examples.text_en: The entertainer made the children laugh all night.
examples.text_zh: 这位艺人让孩子们笑了一整晚。

examples.text_en: A famous entertainer came to our small town.
examples.text_zh: 一位著名的艺人来到我们的小镇。

examples.text_en: The story enthralled the children for hours.
examples.text_zh: 这个故事让孩子们着迷了好几个小时。

examples.text_en: Her singing enthralled the small crowd.
examples.text_zh: 她的歌声迷住了这一小群听众。

examples.text_en: The bright stars enthrall every child.
examples.text_zh: 明亮的星星让每个孩子着迷。

examples.text_en: Magic shows enthrall people of all ages.
examples.text_zh: 魔术表演让各个年龄的人着迷。

examples.text_en: It was an enthralling tale of the sea.
examples.text_zh: 那是一个关于大海的迷人故事。

examples.text_en: The game proved enthralling to watch.
examples.text_zh: 这场比赛看起来十分迷人。

examples.text_en: They tried to entice him with a big offer.
examples.text_zh: 他们想用优厚的条件引诱他。

examples.text_en: The fine light can entice people into the store.
examples.text_zh: 明亮的灯光能把人吸引进店里。

examples.text_en: He read the entirety of the long report.
examples.text_zh: 他读完了这份长报告的全部内容。

examples.text_en: The entirety of the plan was kept in secret.
examples.text_zh: 整个计划的全部内容都被保密。

examples.text_en: This note will entitle you to a free book.
examples.text_zh: 这张凭证将使你有权得到一本赠书。

examples.text_en: They will entitle the new film with her name.
examples.text_zh: 他们会用她的名字给这部新电影命名。

examples.text_en: The company is a single entity in the market.
examples.text_zh: 这家公司在市场上是一个单一的实体。

examples.text_en: They treated the group as one entity.
examples.text_zh: 他们把这个群体当作一个整体。

examples.text_en: A large entourage followed the famous singer.
examples.text_zh: 一大群随行人员跟着那位著名歌手。

examples.text_en: The minister arrived with his entire entourage.
examples.text_zh: 部长带着全体随行人员到达。

examples.text_en: The music was entrancing and we stayed for hours.
examples.text_zh: 音乐令人神魂颠倒，我们待了好几个小时。

examples.text_en: She has an entrancing way of telling a story.
examples.text_zh: 她讲故事的方式令人着迷。

examples.text_en: The police hoped to entrap the thief.
examples.text_zh: 警方想诱捕那个小偷。

examples.text_en: He was entrapped by his own words.
examples.text_zh: 他被他自己的话套住了。

examples.text_en: She would entreat him to stay a little longer.
examples.text_zh: 她会恳求他多待一会儿。

examples.text_en: They entreat us for help in the hard times.
examples.text_zh: 在艰难的日子里，他们恳求我们帮忙。

examples.text_en: She ignored his entreaty for more time.
examples.text_zh: 她无视他多给些时间的恳求。

examples.text_en: His entreaty moved the judge to tears.
examples.text_zh: 他的恳求让法官感动落泪。

examples.text_en: The new rules would entrench the power of a few.
examples.text_zh: 新规则会让少数人的权力更加牢固。

examples.text_en: They tried to entrench their position in the town.
examples.text_zh: 他们设法在镇上巩固自己的地位。

examples.text_en: The custom is deeply entrenched in this area.
examples.text_zh: 这个习俗在这一带根深蒂固。

examples.text_en: Their political views remain firmly entrenched.
examples.text_zh: 他们的政治观点依然十分牢固。

examples.text_en: The vines entwine the garden fence.
examples.text_zh: 藤蔓缠绕着花园的篱笆。

examples.text_en: Their fingers entwined as they walked home.
examples.text_zh: 他们走回家时手指缠在一起。

examples.text_en: Please enunciate your main idea more clearly.
examples.text_zh: 请更清楚地表明你的主要想法。

examples.text_en: She enunciated each word with great care.
examples.text_zh: 她非常小心地把每个词说清楚。

examples.text_en: Tall trees environ the house on all sides.
examples.text_zh: 高大的树木从四面环绕着这座房子。

examples.text_en: High walls environ the ancient garden.
examples.text_zh: 高墙环绕着这座古老的花园。

examples.text_en: They live in the quiet environs of the city.
examples.text_zh: 他们住在城市安静的郊外。

examples.text_en: The environs of the town are quite lovely.
examples.text_zh: 这座小镇的郊外相当美丽。

examples.text_en: We can envisage a better life for the children.
examples.text_zh: 我们可以想象孩子们会有更好的生活。

examples.text_en: He could not envisage a world without music.
examples.text_zh: 他无法想象一个没有音乐的世界。

examples.text_en: She would envision a small house near the sea.
examples.text_zh: 她常常想象海边的一座小房子。

examples.text_en: They envision great changes in the next year.
examples.text_zh: 他们预想明年会有很大的变化。

examples.text_en: The envoy carried a message to the king.
examples.text_zh: 特使把一封信带给了国王。

examples.text_en: A special envoy arrived this morning.
examples.text_zh: 一位特使今天早上到达。

examples.text_en: This enzyme helps break down the food.
examples.text_zh: 这种酶有助于分解食物。

examples.text_en: Heat can destroy the enzyme in milk.
examples.text_zh: 高温会破坏牛奶中的酶。

examples.text_en: The gold epaulet showed his place in the army.
examples.text_zh: 金色的肩章表明他在军中的身份。

examples.text_en: A bright epaulet was on his left side.
examples.text_zh: 他左侧佩戴着一枚明亮的肩章。

examples.text_en: The beauty of the light was ephemeral and brief.
examples.text_zh: 那光影的美短暂而瞬逝。

examples.text_en: Fame can be ephemeral in the world of art.
examples.text_zh: 在艺术界，名声可能是短暂的。

examples.text_en: The epicure knows every fine place in the city.
examples.text_zh: 这位美食家对城里的好去处了如指掌。

examples.text_en: He was a real epicure and loved good food.
examples.text_zh: 他是个真正的美食家，特别喜欢美味。

examples.text_en: The epicurean spent his money on fine food.
examples.text_zh: 这位享乐主义者把钱都花在了美食上。

examples.text_en: They led an epicurean life of music and rest.
examples.text_zh: 他们过着有音乐和休憩的享乐生活。

examples.text_en: The epidermis is the outer part of the skin.
examples.text_zh: 表皮是皮肤的外层部分。

examples.text_en: A small cut can hurt the epidermis.
examples.text_zh: 一道小伤口就能伤到表皮。

examples.text_en: He wrote a clever epigram about love.
examples.text_zh: 他写了一句关于爱情的巧妙警句。

examples.text_en: Her speech ended with a famous epigram.
examples.text_zh: 她的演讲以一句著名的警句结束。

examples.text_en: The epilogue brought the long story to an end.
examples.text_zh: 尾声为这个长长的故事画上了句号。

examples.text_en: He wrote the epilogue in a few short lines.
examples.text_zh: 他用短短的几行写了这个尾声。

examples.text_en: The film was episodic and hard to follow.
examples.text_zh: 这部电影像是由一段段插曲组成，很难看明白。

examples.text_en: His work was episodic and lacked a clear line.
examples.text_zh: 他的作品像一段段插曲，缺少清晰的线索。

examples.text_en: The stone bears a simple epitaph.
examples.text_zh: 石头上刻着一句简短的墓志铭。

examples.text_en: He wrote his own epitaph years before.
examples.text_zh: 他多年前就写好了自己的墓志铭。

examples.text_en: The boys gave him an unkind epithet.
examples.text_zh: 孩子们给他起了个难听的绰号。

examples.text_en: That epithet has followed him for many years.
examples.text_zh: 那个绰号跟了他许多年。

examples.text_en: She is the epitome of a good teacher.
examples.text_zh: 她是一位好老师的典范。

examples.text_en: The small town was the epitome of quiet life.
examples.text_zh: 这座小镇是宁静生活的缩影。

examples.text_en: These songs epitomize the spirit of summer.
examples.text_zh: 这些歌曲概括了夏天的精神。

examples.text_en: The small cafe epitomizes city life.
examples.text_zh: 这家小咖啡馆概括了城市生活。

examples.text_en: The war marked a new epoch in history.
examples.text_zh: 这场战争标志着历史上的一个新纪元。

examples.text_en: We live in a remarkable epoch of change.
examples.text_zh: 我们生活在一个非凡的变革时代。

examples.text_en: The money was shared equally between the friends.
examples.text_zh: 钱在几个朋友之间平分了。

examples.text_en: All the children were treated equally at school.
examples.text_zh: 所有孩子在学校都受到同等对待。

examples.text_en: She took the bad news with great equanimity.
examples.text_zh: 她非常镇定地接受了这个坏消息。

examples.text_en: He faced the loss with equanimity and hope.
examples.text_zh: 他平静而充满希望地面对损失。

examples.text_en: She won a prize in the equestrian event.
examples.text_zh: 她在马术项目中获奖。

examples.text_en: His equestrian skills impressed the crowd.
examples.text_zh: 他的骑术让观众赞叹。

examples.text_en: The farmer keeps three equines on his land.
examples.text_zh: 农场主在自己的地里养了三匹马。

examples.text_en: An equine stood quietly near the gate.
examples.text_zh: 一匹马静静地站在门边。

examples.text_en: The French equipe won the race last year.
examples.text_zh: 这支法国运动队去年赢得了比赛。

examples.text_en: The racing equipe trained hard for months.
examples.text_zh: 这支比赛队苦练了好几个月。

examples.text_en: We need a fair and equitable solution.
examples.text_zh: 我们需要一个公平公正的解决办法。

examples.text_en: The judge gave an equitable decision.
examples.text_zh: 法官作出了公正的裁决。

examples.text_en: They asked for equity in the new law.
examples.text_zh: 他们要求新法律体现公平。

examples.text_en: The judge spoke about equity and the common good.
examples.text_zh: 法官谈到了公平与共同的利益。

examples.text_en: His answer was equivocal and helped no one.
examples.text_zh: 他的回答模棱两可，谁也帮不了。

examples.text_en: The words of the note were equivocal to us.
examples.text_zh: 便条上的话在我们看来意义不明。

examples.text_en: He would equivocate when we asked him directly.
examples.text_zh: 我们直接问他时，他就支支吾吾。

examples.text_en: Do not equivocate about the time of the meeting.
examples.text_zh: 不要对会议时间含糊其辞。

examples.text_en: His answer was full of equivocation.
examples.text_zh: 他的回答满是模棱两可的话。

examples.text_en: The report avoids any equivocation on this.
examples.text_zh: 这份报告在这一点上没有任何含糊话。

examples.text_en: They hope to eradicate the disease soon.
examples.text_zh: 他们希望不久就能根除这种疾病。

examples.text_en: We must eradicate poverty in our region.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须根除本地区的贫困。

examples.text_en: The erasure of the name caused a stir.
examples.text_zh: 擦掉这个名字引起了一阵轰动。

examples.text_en: Careful erasure left no mark on the page.
examples.text_zh: 小心的擦除在纸上没有留下痕迹。

examples.text_en: Heavy rain caused serious soil erosion here.
examples.text_zh: 大雨在这里造成了严重的水土侵蚀。

examples.text_en: Coastal erosion threatens many small villages.
examples.text_zh: 海岸侵蚀威胁着许多小村庄。

examples.text_en: The man was known as an erratic.
examples.text_zh: 大家都把这个人当作一个古怪的人。

examples.text_en: They called the newcomer an erratic.
examples.text_zh: 他们把这位新来的人叫作古怪的人。

examples.text_en: The car moved erratically along the road.
examples.text_zh: 汽车沿着公路不规律地行驶。

examples.text_en: His heart beat erratically for a moment.
examples.text_zh: 他的心脏一时间不规律地跳动。

examples.text_en: His erroneous idea caused a lot of trouble.
examples.text_zh: 他错误的想法惹来了不少麻烦。

examples.text_en: The report was full of erroneous facts.
examples.text_zh: 这份报告里满是错误的事实。

examples.text_en: The ersatz was cheap but had no taste.
examples.text_zh: 这种代用品很便宜，却毫无味道。

examples.text_en: They used ersatz in place of the real thing.
examples.text_zh: 他们用代用品代替了真品。

examples.text_en: The erstwhile friends met again after many years.
examples.text_zh: 从前的朋友多年后又见面了。

examples.text_en: He spoke of his erstwhile home with great care.
examples.text_zh: 他满怀深情地谈起从前的家。

examples.text_en: The erudite professor explained the theory simply.
examples.text_zh: 这位博学的教授简单地解释了那个理论。

examples.text_en: She gave an erudite talk on art.
examples.text_zh: 她就艺术做了一场博学的演讲。

examples.text_en: The volcanic eruption destroyed several villages.
examples.text_zh: 火山爆发毁掉了好几个村庄。

examples.text_en: A sudden eruption of anger surprised us.
examples.text_zh: 突然爆发的怒气让我们很意外。

examples.text_en: The small fight could escalate into a big one.
examples.text_zh: 这场小争执可能逐步升级成大打出手。

examples.text_en: Prices may escalate if we do nothing now.
examples.text_zh: 如果我们现在不作应对，价格可能逐步上涨。

examples.text_en: The escalation of the fight worried the town.
examples.text_zh: 冲突的升级让镇上的人很担心。

examples.text_en: We must stop the escalation of these prices.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须阻止这些价格的不断上涨。

examples.text_en: Reading novels is a harmless form of escapism.
examples.text_zh: 读小说是一种无害的逃避现实。

examples.text_en: Some see games as pure escapism.
examples.text_zh: 有些人把游戏看作纯粹的逃避现实。

examples.text_en: He enjoys escapist films about far lands.
examples.text_zh: 他喜欢看关于遥远地方的逃避现实的电影。

examples.text_en: That escapist novel sold very well.
examples.text_zh: 那本逃避现实的小说卖得很好。

examples.text_en: They eschew fine words and ask for hard facts.
examples.text_zh: 他们避开漂亮话，只求确凿的事实。

examples.text_en: He would eschew the city for a quiet life.
examples.text_zh: 他会远离城市，去过安静的生活。

examples.text_en: The escort stayed with her through the long night.
examples.text_zh: 护卫整夜都陪着她。

examples.text_en: A small escort led the group to the city.
examples.text_zh: 一小队护卫把人群领到城里。

examples.text_en: Food moves down the esophagus to the body.
examples.text_zh: 食物顺着食道进入身体。

examples.text_en: The doctor looked at his esophagus with care.
examples.text_zh: 医生仔细检查了他的食道。

examples.text_en: The lecture dealt with esoteric subjects.
examples.text_zh: 这场讲座涉及一些奥秘的主题。

examples.text_en: His notes are full of esoteric terms.
examples.text_zh: 他的笔记里满是秘传的术语。

examples.text_en: His espousal of the plan surprised everyone.
examples.text_zh: 他对这个计划的拥护让所有人都很意外。

examples.text_en: Her espousal of free trade is well known.
examples.text_zh: 她对自由贸易的拥护广为人知。

examples.text_en: From the hill we espied a small boat.
examples.text_zh: 我们从山上望见了一条小船。

examples.text_en: She espied a figure near the gate.
examples.text_zh: 她发现门边有个人影。

examples.text_en: The establishment of the new school took years.
examples.text_zh: 新学校的建立花了好几年。

examples.text_en: They met at a small establishment near the sea.
examples.text_zh: 他们在海边一家小场所见了面。

examples.text_en: He left the estate to his two sons.
examples.text_zh: 他把这份不动产留给了两个儿子。

examples.text_en: The family estate passed to a cousin.
examples.text_zh: 家族的不动产传给了一位表亲。

examples.text_en: Her students hold her in high esteem.
examples.text_zh: 她的学生非常尊敬她。

examples.text_en: He lost the esteem of his colleagues.
examples.text_zh: 他失去了同事们的尊重。

examples.text_en: The room had a fine esthetic quality about it.
examples.text_zh: 这个房间有一种雅致的审美格调。

examples.text_en: They talked about the esthetic side of the design.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈论了这个设计的审美一面。

examples.text_en: He was an estimable man and a true friend.
examples.text_zh: 他是一位可敬的人，也是个真诚的朋友。

examples.text_en: The estimable teacher helped the poor for years.
examples.text_zh: 这位可敬的老师帮助穷人许多年。

examples.text_en: Constant fighting is estranging the two sides.
examples.text_zh: 不断的争吵正使双方渐渐疏远。

examples.text_en: Long silence can estrange close friends.
examples.text_zh: 长久的沉默会使亲密的朋友疏远。
